service.description: Link or change the mobile number on Aadhaar. It is done only at an Aadhaar centre with the person's fingerprint — the appointment is booked online.
service.depending: Aadhaar Card, the new mobile number; the person must go to the Aadhaar centre
service.rules: The mobile number can not be updated online — the person's biometrics are needed at an Aadhaar centre. Keep the acknowledgement slip of the centre.
